title: nmea0183: Add VBW sentence dissector
description:
Add sentence dissector for VBW messages.

* It uses the existing dissector for the fields.
* Report an expected but missing field

### Tested

This pcap contains valid and invalid variants of VBW sentence: [nmea-test-messages.pcapng](/uploads/f832fa95e449cb78445b6e9d2e25b10a/nmea-test-messages.pcapng)

I have run 500 iterations of `fuzz-test.sh` with that capture.
